_about: Thomas Davidson (1840-1900), Scottish-American wandering scholar, translator of Rosmini and founder of the Fellowship of the New Life. Bakewell (Boston: Ginn, 1906), clean 0.94. Held: Prolegomena to In Memoriam (1889), OCR below 0.78. His Rosmini translations are on the rosmini shelf.
